training_evidence: Old own-Ridge full correction is harmful in earlier training origins. Descriptive oracle quadratic scales on o70 are0.173/0.386, on o80 are0.294/0.796, versus o90 1.578/0.922. These are diagnostic training evidence only, NEVER inference coefficients. New coefficients use a distinct nested calibration interval BEFORE each query origin.
data: Same original seven own-turbine features, raw labels, target/input scaler, input72/h2/stride3, six units and unchanged outer cohort. No neighbor inputs, future weather, original data editing, clipping or dropped samples.
partition: At each v12 origin, fit fixed Ridge alpha100 on first90% of AVAILABLE training prefix; purged last10% calibrates. Original scaler fitting outcomes must precede first calibration issue. Query is next original training origin, never used for calibration. For final pipeline, fit first90% original outer-train, calibrate last10%, keep EXACT frozen expert; do NOT refit it after calibration.
calibration: Per lead, analytically choose alpha_MSE=clip(sum(delta*innovation)/sum(delta^2),0,1); if it violates calibration MAE<=Persistence, find the largest feasible alpha in[0,alpha_MSE] by64step convex bisection. Tinyalpha<1e-10=>0; numerical loss tolerance1e-12*max(1,baseline MAE). This is fitted calibration, not validation hyperparameter search. Bind coefficients to exact expert file+array hashes and original scaler.
comparisons: RidgeUnscaled and RidgeJointShrink use SAME expert checkpoint and same fitting/calibration label budget. Unscaled ignores calibration labels; shrink fits two coefficients. Compare against exact Persistence. Historical models have different budgets, not tuned SOTA.
selection: Same v12 robust train-only selection: fixed algorithm must be jointly non-worse on MAE/RMSE in ALL3 training origins, tolerance1e-8; minimize mean per-origin mean error ratios, require aggregate<1-1e-8. Tie fewer learned coefficients then name. No eligible=>exact Persistence. No epoch, threshold, seed or runner-up search.
budget: Three new Ridge expert fits and three bound calibrators, two read-only variants each. At most ONE selected final pipeline; its exact90% Ridge expert must reuse completed v11 checkpoint if windows/algorithm/scaler/code/hash match, otherwise stop instead of retraining an allegedly identical expert. No extra candidates or seeds.
primary_success: Both outer MAE and RMSE improve vs exact Persistence and frozen original numerical base. Learned numerical calibration only, not Wiki/novelty proof or independent confirmation.
resource_policy: CPU only, own BLAS/OpenMP2threads. Never initialize CUDA for this trial, signal/throttle another user, or run duplicate suite.
limitations: Repeatedly inspected developmental periods; two coefficient calibration can drift and collapse to Persistence. Different data partition from v13; this protocol tests calibrated pipeline, not pure architecture superiority. No outer-driven replacement or same-expert refit after calibration.
